method: Logical discrimination only. A model class survives an outcome unless a recorded or derived consequence of that outcome contradicts one of its required predicates. display_order.note: Category orders are for display and tie listing only. They are not weights and are never summed.

limits: No probabilities, likelihoods, priors, expected values or information-gain numbers are computed. Every count is a count of logically distinguished classes, pairs or records.
Every record dependency has at least one outcome (inconclusive, partial or not obtainable) under which every class survives. No set of records can guarantee separation in the worst case.

Archaeological outcomes can only exclude the branch they examine. A compatible outcome never excludes another site's branch, so no archaeological record guarantees separation even when it is decisive.

Separation is relative to the registered branches. Each roster is a selected set; an unenumerated alternative is never excluded by these records, and separating the registered classes identifies nothing.

Derived outcome refinements follow the existing predicates (relationships exists_during and coexisted_with windows, inventory aspect and phase checks, protocol letter components). They are planning branches, not observations.
Selecting or ranking a record does not send a request, record an outcome, reopen a closed test or change any task status.
